neighbours.label: a demonstrative determiner (' this', ' these', ' that') mid-sentence pointing back to a thing just mentioned
fire: The robot can sort parcels, and it does that one job faster than any worker.
Critics focus on the links between cells rather than the traits of these cells themselves.
The rule of buoyancy explains why ships float. This principle was first stated by Archimedes.
She proposed a new tax on sugar, but the council rejected this idea within a week.
Several farms switched to drip irrigation, and these farms now use half the water.
He kept one notebook for every trip, and he still reads that notebook every winter.
The bridge was designed to sway in the wind; this feature saved it during the storm.
Two vaccines were trialled last year, and both of these vaccines passed safety checks.
quiet: The robot can sort parcels, and it does it faster than any worker in the warehouse.
Critics focus on the links between cells rather than on what cells are made of.
The rule of buoyancy explains why ships float, and Archimedes first stated it long ago.
She proposed a new tax on sugar, but the council rejected it within a week.
Several farms switched to drip irrigation, and now they use half as much water.
He kept one notebook for every trip, and he still reads them every winter.
The bridge was designed to sway in the wind, which saved it during the storm.
Two vaccines were trialled last year, and both passed their safety checks easily.

notes: card top: ' this'/' these'/' that'/' a' at NP start; the label guesses the anaphoric demonstrative is the driver
